items.title: Full pytest-run suite (27,925 tests) takes 40-53 min per run vs 14.4 min measured at CI-DIET (10-13); each full run holds 1 of the 20 hosted-runner slots 3-4x longer, saturating Actions (MEASURED 2026-11-12: jobs 131070147506 2397s, 131060816113 3209s, image ubuntu-26.04 20261101.186.1; scoped runs ~3.2k tests still 7-12 min). Find the cause with a --durations compare (slow files, xdist worker count, network or sleep in tests); fix it in the tests, never by deselecting.

Implement operator gate decisions 2026-11-12 (CI + landing): required checks -> [guards]; 16 run_guards guards report-only; PRL R7/R8/R9/R14 removed, R6 report-only; system-actions concurrency report-only
docs/api-tier-policy.md literal route-count headline turns every route-adding PR red after another lands

Research dispatch fired 0 units 17:43Z..22:33Z on 2026-11-12 (infra yield always met: system-actions + phone-executor-apk kept >= 2 fresh infra runs queued). Manager decision 22:33Z: infra-yield starvation floor (2 h, one fire/cycle), drop phone-executor-apk from infra_workflows, research-queue-health idle page 12 h -> 4 h. PR #25526. Done when the first unit fires after deploy (dispatch run id + unit id recorded). Gates: none.

Adopt build_table(hole_safe=True) (from #25460) in every ml_decision_entry consumer: the grade, the diag and the retrain/dataset scripts. Positional rolling features/ATR spanning a bar hole corrupt 168 bars after it. MEASURED: one 2026-10-28 hole moved a 14-day grade from -0.2127 to -0.1316 (n 373 -> 317). Steps: (1) census the historic bar holes in the crypto 1h lake (count, symbols, dates); (2) switch the default to hole-safe and re-grade the affected committed records, recording old vs new; (3) for training sets, rebuild hole-safe and record the feature diff. A served-model retrain follows the normal evidence path. NOT a refusal: a window with a gap is regridded and graded, never refused (operator 2026-11-12, no new gates). Done when the census is committed and every consumer builds hole-safe by default. Gates: none.
BRACKETS and HOLD/ADJUST/CLOSE read the same feature store: BRACKETS re-scored on v2 features 2026-11-02T12:00Z; in-trade path features from the store 2026-11-03T12:00Z

System-wide config rule: accounts configure only which strategies/MLs are active; no per-symbol config; an ML's traded symbols are internal to the ML, set by which per-symbol tests passed. Codify in the canonical docs and apply to every ML
CME micro intraday history (real contract) for MES/MNQ/MGC 1m-5m, point-in-time with rolls, 2019+: IB historical via ict-ib-gateway or Databento GLBX.MDP3 (spend decision)
